summary: Abacus Global Management filed an 8-K announcing the closing of its $52.9 million acquisition of a minority indirect position in Manning Napier. The deal was previously announced March 12, 2026. Abacus joins other institutional investors. A Strategic Alliance Agreement was also entered for collaboration on lead generation, product development, and joint client solutions, leveraging Abacus's longevity data. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. No specific price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor names were disclosed. Watch for operational integration and potential further strategic moves as the partnership unfolds.
